verdict.rationale: Working Copy exposes automation surfaces (Shortcuts, x-callback-url, WebDAV) and includes a Repository Agent, so issuing scoped credentials for agents is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials. SSH key identities, Secure Enclave key storage and the AWS IAM policy requirement are adjacent controls or host-platform features, not agent credential scoping.
